description: Finds cards by name (last word prefix-matched), or by the set code and collector number printed on the card (e.g. game "pokemon", set_code "OBF", number "125"), or both. Give at least one of q, set_code or number. Returns card ids needed by every price tool. `printings_count` means other printings of the card exist. Available on the free plan. Cost: 1 unit.

game.description: Restrict to one game id. Required with set_code.

lang.description: Card language (en, de, fr, it, es, ja, zh): only cards that sold in that language.

number.description: Collector number; "125", "0125" and "125/197" are the same.

q.description: Card name, e.g. "charizard ex". Optional when set_code or number is given.

set_code.description: Set code printed on the card, e.g. "OBF" (English Pokemon) or the set id for other games. Needs game.

set_id.description: Restrict to one set_id from flipzi_list_sets.

name: flipzi_search_cards
title: Search cards by name, set code or number
